# CityMETER · Commercial District

> The central neighbourhood registry of CityMETER (release 2026-11-17: 358 closed draft outlines, plus 37 lodging areas of its lodging screen counted as neighbourhoods here by the owner's decision of 2026-11-18 and, since 0.5.0, codes of its commercial screen that the owner's rule outlined from their reference points (139 in 0.7.8); 534 outlines in 77 provinces, 318.1 km², 235 of them redrawn by the owner's rule since 0.3.0) against the located records of 16 CityMETER demo datasets — Land (hotels, industrial estates, offices, shopping centers), Location (camera shops, factories, fitness, grocery, luxury brands, pharmacies, restaurants), Living (government offices, hospitals, schools, rail stations, universities): what each neighbourhood stands out for against named peers, which datasets rise together across neighbourhoods, which neighbourhoods have a similar mix, and up to four side by side. A Landometer CityMETER demo, release 0.7.8 (2026-11-27), Thai with an English reading (?lang=en). Registry read 2026-11-26; each dataset's date is its own.

What one figure means:
- neighbourhood = a closed draft outline of the central registry (code CMN-TH-…). Drafts pending local confirmation: not an administrative boundary, a legal line or a title. 27 more registry codes have no closed outline yet; they are searchable, never counted.
- count = a dataset's records with a point inside the outline, in the dataset's own unit (places, branches, stores, points of sale, registrations, records, station-line records). Counts of two datasets are never added.
- per km² = count ÷ the area of the neighbourhood's outline (the registry's, or the owner's amendment of it: 0.2.4, 0.3.0).
- no data (—) = the dataset has no located record in the neighbourhood's province: unknown, never 0. 0 = the dataset reaches the province, nothing of it lies inside the outline.
- share = a dataset's records inside the neighbourhoods ÷ its located records (nationwide or in the province).
- highlight = near the top among named peers: ≥ 5% of the dataset's located records nationwide, a count or density rank in the top quarter (with the number of peers), or one of the few neighbourhoods holding any.
- comes together = Spearman's ρ of density across the neighbourhoods both datasets cover (a correlation, not a cause).
- similar mix = correlation of centred log density across the datasets two neighbourhoods share (an inference, a starting point for a comparison).
- people (0.7.0, data/people/<id>.json) = three figures never added together: residents (modelled: the civil register of 2026-10 per subdistrict spread over CityMETER Building V4 by floor area; inside and within 400 m to 5 km since 0.7.3), people who come to work and study (at least: recorded students, factory workers, government staff and modelled office workers, parts beside the sum), overnight visitors (guests a year: the province’s guests of the Ministry of Tourism and Sports, Table 17.1 of 2024, shared by recorded rooms) — inside and within 1 · 3 · 5 km of the edge (a straight line on the neighbourhood's bank; across a river through the nearest crossing since 0.7.5); never footfall, customers or sales.
- round map (0.7.0) = places of the listed datasets per 250 m cell within 5 km of the edge (an inference of where people go), colours ranked within one map; since 0.7.1 the sea, water areas, rivers, major roads, rail and stations from OpenStreetMap (the Shopping Center page's extract of 2026-11-24, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) to read it by — never counted, never a distance.
- the groups (0.7.4) = in the owner's order, residents › visitors › commuters, in the tiles and the round map's tabs; the residents map opens first.
- across a river (0.7.5, DATA_METHOD.md §17) = on the neighbourhood's bank the straight line from the edge; across a barrier river (OpenStreetMap rivers named แม่น้ำ… or with an English name “… River”) the distance through the nearest crossing (bridge, road, footbridge, metro, ferry up to 1.6 km) — edge → crossing → place, each leg straight; the Shopping Center page's rule (D70) from the same file; a model of reach, not walking or driving time. Residents, the people figures, their levels, the round maps and the 400/800 m counts take it; data/people/<id>.json st keeps the straight figures wherever one differs.
- residents (0.7.3) = registered residents (civil register, Oct 2026) spread over CityMETER Building V4 by floor area — modelled, inside and within 1 · 3 · 5 km of the edge and per 250 m cell on the residents map; never people actually living there, footfall or customers.

Snapshot (release 0.3.0; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 534 neighbourhoods = 0.062% of the area of the 77 provinces, but 71% of the located luxury points of sale (245 of 345), 48% of the fitness branches (72 of 149), 48% of the camera shops (114 of 236), 44% of the offices (189 of 427), 31% of the rail station-line records (94 of 301); 0 of 69 industrial estates (release 0.7.8).
- Lodging screen of the registry (0.2.0): 268 proposals from 30,730 lodging records, walking 400/800 m; 193 supported, 75 held; shown per neighbourhood as a walking model, not a survey.
- Bangkok: 76 neighbourhoods = 2.2% of the province; 82% of its luxury points of sale (232 of 284).
- Strongest pairs: camera shops + luxury brands ρ 0.68 (143 neighbourhoods), offices + fitness 0.55, camera shops + fitness 0.55, fitness + luxury brands 0.55, fitness + pharmacies 0.46.

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/):
- ?at={province code} — e.g. BKK, CMI, PKT (production codes)
- ?f.neighborhood={CMN-TH code} — a neighbourhood (with its province in at)
- ?m={dataset} — colour by one dataset's density: hotel, industrialestate, office, shoppingcenter, camera, factory, fitness, grocery, luxurybrands, pharmacy, restaurant, governmentoffice, hospital, school, transit, university
- Rail context of the map (0.2.3): urban rail lines in service (solid) and under construction (dashed), stations, interchanges and the national rail stops with scheduled trips, from CityMETER Transit (data/rail.json; the stations are the file the dataset สถานีราง counts) — drawn in one neutral ink under the neighbourhoods, never counted. Choosing a neighbourhood fits the map to its outline.
- 0.2.4: the rail is drawn in a darker neutral ink and wider (still under the outlines); the outline of นิมมาน–เมญ่า (CMN-TH-FB55C19EF1, Chiang Mai) is extended across Huay Kaew Road to take in Maya, Kad Rin Kham, The Wall and Chiang Mai Polytechnic College, on the owner's word of 18 Nov 2026, drawn by the registry's outline rules from the registry outline and OpenStreetMap ways (amendments/; rows[].amended, meta.amendments) — awaiting the registry's next release
- 0.3.0: 235 outlines redrawn by the owner's rule of 24 Nov 2026 replace the registry's (amendments/, rows[].amended with rule, meta.amendments): the buildings that run on from the registry outline, within ground the basemap does not mark as forest, field, water or industrial land, split halfway with a neighbour where the built-up ground joins, and within limits the owner set for 6 places; the other 160 keep their outline (the registry's, or นิมมาน–เมญ่า's of 0.2.4). Every count, density, rank, highlight and pair uses the outline shown; the registry record says it was extended and awaits the registry's next release
- 0.2.5: a neighbourhood's area reads in rai (ไร่; 1 rai = 1,600 m²) instead of hectares — list, card, comparison, table and provenance — with its km² in the area tile's hover text, since every density is per km²
- 0.4.0: «ในย่านนี้» and «รอบย่านนี้» (data/around.json, DATA_METHOD.md §12, handoff/around/): four glance tiles of one dataset each (residents: modelled, not yet; students the school dataset records; rooms the lodging dataset records; shopping centres and markets) with the five-step level of «รอบศูนย์นี้» among the 395 neighbourhoods of the release; per dataset the records outside the outline within 400 m and 800 m of its edge, straight line (800 holds 400; a record counted inside is never around; never added across datasets or neighbourhoods); the centres with a «รอบศูนย์นี้» page inside and near; datasets with points for under 90% of their records starred and never ranked there; count highlights say how many neighbourhoods share the rank
- 0.5.1: logos beside the names (data/logos/<id>.json, assets/logos/, data/logos-report.json, DATA_METHOD.md §13): files the family's demos already ship, checked by SHA-256 and joined by ids only (brand id, Shopping Center venue id, Office ID, rail line); in the card, the map's spot names, the lists and the centres «รอบย่านนี้» names; decorative, never counted or ranked
- 0.6.0: the panel reads visual first (DATA_METHOD.md §14, handoff/visual/): a fingerprint of the 16 datasets per neighbourhood (six cell states: a level's colour, a dot, a dashed edge, a thick outline, a hatch, a ring for a highlight); a level per dataset = the mean of the count level and the density level (mid-rank 0–100) among the neighbourhoods with at least 3 records — a level within a declared group, never a total, coloured on the LDS count LUT (an owner-approved exception to DATAVIZ-02, the map keeps density); highlights only on datasets with points for at least 90% of their records; the axes อยู่ · เที่ยว · ค้าขาย (Live · Visit · Trade: no score, no total, one axis per dataset, “?” for indicators with no data yet) in place of the 0.4.0 table, which stays whole in a closed part; a matrix of neighbourhoods × 16 datasets wherever several neighbourhoods show; the comparison as shapes on a dot chart
- 0.6.1: the owner's answers of 2026-11-26 10:02 on the commercial screen's outlines (amendments/outline-new-choices-2026-11-26.json, amendments/outline-new-2026-11-26-r2.geojson, DATA_METHOD.md §2e): 13 outlines over 1 km used as he chose, 3 set aside, 1 with its narrow arms off waiting for his look; the codes without buildings drawn again with CityMETER Building V4 (5 within 1 km on the page, 64 waiting for his tick); ย่านตลาดไท kept, drawn from the market and ตลาดไอยรา, waiting for his tick; a V4 outline says so in its registry record
- 0.7.8: the owner's ticks of 2026-11-27 10:44 on the 66 outlines 0.6.1 left waiting (amendments/outline-new-choices-2026-11-27.json, amendments/outline-new-2026-11-27-r3.geojson, DATA_METHOD.md §2f): 13 used as drawn (ย่านตลาดไท among them), 11 with their narrow arms off, 41 cut to the part within 1 km of the reference point (a rule he accepted); one code taken off the screen (not a commercial neighbourhood: neither drawn nor listed); no outline waits for a tick; a registry record says when his tick changed the outline; «รอบย่านนี้», the logos and «ใครอยู่ตรงนี้» for all 534, the 469 earlier ones byte for byte unchanged
- ?f.around={400 or 800} — with a neighbourhood open, the table stresses that column and the map draws the line at that distance (0.4.0); inside is the default and never written
- ?f.kind={registry, lodging or added} — the kind of neighbourhood shown (0.2.0): the registry's outlines, the lodging areas, or those first drawn in this release
- ?f.show={dataset, condo or all} — with a neighbourhood open, one set at a time: its records larger with names, the others small dots (0.1.3); without it a neighbourhood opens on its first highlight with records, or on the ?m dataset when it has records there (0.1.4); all = every set alike
- ?cmp={code},{code}… — compare up to four · ?f.search={text} · ?v3d=0 — plan view · ?lang=en — English

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, placement, coverage, highlights, pairs, roles, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/data/neighborhoods.json): neighbourhoods, datasets with their sources, roles, pairs, pending codes, provenance (meta)
- [Outlines](https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/data/boundaries.geojson) · Records inside one neighbourhood: data/records/{CMN-TH code}.json (key, names, figure; each opens in its own demo at ?e=<kind>:<key>) · Condominium display points (never counted): data/condo/index.json and its 0.1° cells
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/commercialdistrict/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Ask Google: every view links to a Google Search for the question of the view. Google's answers are not CityMETER data and are never copied into it.

Do not claim from this data: footfall, sales, revenue, demand or market share; that two datasets cause each other; that an outline is an official or legal boundary; that a neighbourhood without data in a dataset has none of it; a total of all POIs.
